target_pattern: Use conditional forms to soften requests and invitations, express future-in-the-past in reported speech, and build hypotheticals with si + imperfect subjunctive + conditional.

cognitive_shift.english_trap: Treating would as one direct translation and missing when Spanish uses conditional as a social softener.
cognitive_shift.spanish_logic: Conditional in Spanish is a function pattern: polite distance, projected action from past, and hypothetical consequence.
target_pattern_formula: conditional stem + ia endings across all verb groups
natural_examples: Podria decirme la hora, por favor?
Ella dijo que llegaria mas tarde.
Si tuviera mas tiempo, estudiaria mas.
Si fueramos vecinos, nos veriamos mas.

pattern_mutation.instructions: Transform each base sentence as instructed.
drills: Base: Podria ayudarme con esto? -> change to informal tu.
Base: Te gustaria venir conmigo? -> change to formal usted.
Base: Ella dijo que llegaria tarde. -> change subject to ellos and action to esperar.
Base: Pense que llegariamos a tiempo. -> change to singular yo and verb to terminar.
Base: Si tuviera mas tiempo, estudiaria mas. -> change subject to nosotros.
Base: Si yo fuera rico, compraria una casa. -> change noun to apartamento.
Base: Si estudiaras mas, pasarias el examen. -> change to ustedes.
Base: Le gustaria acompanarnos a cenar? -> change invitation to desayunar manana.
Base: Podrias abrir la puerta? -> make it negative.
Base: Dijo que me llamaria. -> change indirect object to nos.
Base: Si ellos vivieran cerca, nos visitarian. -> change frequency to todos los fines de semana.
Base: Si supiera cocinar, prepararia la cena. -> change meal to almuerzo.
Base: Podria explicarme este ejercicio? -> replace with seria posible + infinitive pattern.
Base: Nos dijeron que vendrian hoy. -> change day to manana.
Base: Si pudieramos tomar vacaciones, iriamos a la playa. -> change destination to la montana.

contrastive_discrimination.instructions: Choose the most natural option for each context.
prompts: Polite formal request: Could you help me? (Podria ayudarme? vs Puedes ayudarme?)
Informal invitation: Would you like to come? (Te gustaria venir? vs Le gustaria venir?)
Reported promise from past: He said he would call. (Dijo que llamaria. vs Dijo que llama.)
Hypothetical unreal present: If I had time, I would go. (Si tuviera tiempo, iria. vs Si tengo tiempo, iria.)
Formal possibility phrasing: Would it be possible to talk now? (Seria posible hablar ahora? vs Es posible hablar ahora?)
Offer with social softening: Would you like coffee? (Le gustaria tomar cafe? vs Quieres cafe?)
Future-in-the-past with nosotros: We thought we would finish today. (Pensamos que terminariamos hoy. vs Pensamos que terminamos hoy.)
Hypothetical with you informal: If you studied more, you would pass. (Si estudiaras mas, pasarias. vs Si estudias mas, pasarias.)
Conditional ability: I would be able to go tomorrow. (Podria ir manana. vs Puedo ir manana.)
Hypothetical with ser: If she were the boss, she would change it. (Si ella fuera la jefa, lo cambiaria. vs Si ella era la jefa, lo cambiaria.)

common_errors.mistake: Puedes ayudarme? in formal customer-service context
common_errors.why_it_happens: Learner uses present tense directness instead of softened request.

common_errors.mistake: Le gustaria venir? addressed to a friend
common_errors.why_it_happens: Formality level does not match relationship.
Real condition and hypothetical condition are mixed.
Conditional is incorrectly used in the si clause.

common_errors.mistake: Seria posible que cambiar la cita?
common_errors.why_it_happens: Infinitive vs subordinate clause structure gets blended.
Extra preposition is inserted before infinitive.

common_errors.mistake: Si fuera la jefa, cambia muchas cosas
common_errors.why_it_happens: Conditional consequence is replaced by present tense.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Si fuera la jefa, cambiaria muchas cosas.

common_errors.mistake: Nos dijeron que van a esperar
common_errors.why_it_happens: Reported speech timeframe is not shifted.

common_errors.mistake: Would like translated only as querer in all contexts
common_errors.why_it_happens: Politeness register in Spanish is overlooked.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Use gustaria or podria for softer tone.
